title: The Rewind: Us and Them
summary:
One of the most significant ways in which these differences manifest themselves is in terms of
attitude toward risk. If you're confident that you know what the future holds,
risk isn't frightening. Our kind of investor is preoccupied by risk, whereas I think the
other is often oblivious to it.
